description: This file defines the Salary class within the OrangeHRM HR management system, extending ListableDisplayField to specify display attributes for salary-related report fields.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: Represents a salary display field in reports, extending ListableDisplayField to provide salary-specific data transfer object class, entity alias, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Salary DTO associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the report, in this case ['salary'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields related to employee salary, specifically ['employee.empNumber'].
